units.source_text: 這是鈣片，這是澱粉酶，可以治療腸胃病。

en.t: These are calcium tablets; this is amylase, which can treat stomach and intestinal trouble.

units.source_text: 這是什麼，那個怎麼服用，她充滿愛心地給我介紹了五六種藥，

en.t: She lovingly explained to me five or six kinds of medicine, telling me what this was and how to take that,

units.source_text: 但這位不幸的老闆娘，她的愛對於我來說太過沉重。

en.t: But for me, the love of this unfortunate proprietress was far too heavy to bear.

units.source_text: 最後她囑咐我「這個藥是你實在控制不住想喝酒的時候服用的」之後，

en.t: Finally, after telling me, “This medicine is for when you truly cannot keep yourself from wanting to drink,”

units.source_text: 迅速將藥包在一個小紙盒裡。

en.t: she quickly wrapped the medicine in a small paper box.
It was a morphine injection solution.
